adminTourWelcomeText: This is where you build themed paths and stations for the app. In a few steps, I'll show you where everything is – nothing will be changed along the way.
adminTourWelcomeHint: You can open the introduction at any time from the top right.
adminTourUnsavedText: The introduction moves across several pages. Save or discard your changes first, then we can get started.
adminTourPathsText: Each themed path is a walk through the town. The numbered dots are its stations: filled means visible, dashed means draft.
adminTourNewPathText: Start a new walk here with a title, description and cover image. It stays a draft until you publish it.
adminTourSidebarText: The sidebar lists all themed paths with their number of stations. The open path expands to show its stations – one click and you're there.
adminTourBreadcrumbsText: Up here you can see where you are. Tap it to go back one level, for example from a path to the overview.
adminTourPathVisibilityText: Drafts are only visible in station management. Use the switch to make the path visible to everyone – we'll ask once more to be safe.
adminTourPathMapText: The line connects the stations in the order visitors walk them. Click a number to open that station.
adminTourPathStationsText: Tap a station to edit it. If there are several, change their order with the arrows on the right.
adminTourNewStationText: A new station starts from a template, such as “Time travel” or “Riddle station”. The template fills in the sequence, then you can adjust everything freely.
adminTourStationVisibilityText: This is where you decide whether visitors can see this station. The change only applies once you save.
adminTourCoverText: The cover image, name and the descriptions below make up the station page visitors see in the app.
adminTourLocationText: Tap the map or drag the golden marker to the right spot. On site, “Use current location” is even quicker.
adminTourModulesText: A station is made of modules that play one after another – for example a story first, then a before/after comparison, and a quiz at the end. Tap a module to edit it.
adminTourAddModuleText: Opens the library with all modules, grouped into Storytelling, Discover & AR and Puzzles. Small sketches show what each module looks like in the app.
adminTourPreviewText: This is how the station looks on a phone – you see every change right away. Use “Play whole station” to try out the sequence.
adminTourPreviewButtonText: Shows the station as it appears on a phone. From there you can also play the whole sequence to try it out.
adminTourActionsText: The language button on the left opens the English version; its number shows missing translations. Unsaved work isn't lost: we ask before you leave, and your browser keeps the draft.
adminTourFirstPathText: A themed path is a walk made of several stations. Start with “Create new themed path” – once there is one, the introduction also shows you stations and the editor.
adminTourFirstStationText: Choose a template via “Create the first station” and fill it with images and texts. Then start the introduction again to see the editor as well.
adminTourHelpText: Use this button to restart the introduction at any time. Have fun creating your stations!
